zh-Hant.name: 迷宮滾球
zh-Hant.summary: 推動小球穿越 3D 木質迷宮，可玩競速、收集星星、地板崩塌與逃出四種模式。競速與逃出各有五種難度、每種 100 關，也可自由練習、對戰電腦或線上同玩。
modes: 競速與逃出：五種難度各 100 關
zh-Hant.controls: 桌機用方向鍵或 WASD；手機、平板用觸控搖桿

zh-Hans.name: 迷宫滚球
zh-Hans.summary: 推动小球穿越 3D 木质迷宫，可玩竞速、收集星星、地板崩塌与逃出四种模式。竞速与逃出各有五种难度、每种 100 关，也可自由练习、对战电脑或线上同玩。
modes: 竞速与逃出：五种难度各 100 关
zh-Hans.controls: 桌机用方向键或 WASD；手机、平板用触控摇杆

en.name: Maze Roll
en.summary: Roll a ball through a 3D wooden maze in four modes: Race, Star Grab, Floor Collapse, and Escape. Race and Escape each have five difficulties with 100 stages per difficulty; you can also practice freely, play against the computer, or join friends online.
modes: Race and Escape: 5 difficulties, 100 stages each
en.controls: Arrow keys or WASD on computers; touch joystick on phones and tablets
